summary: Plan workload sequencing, shared responsibility, service selection, and cloud cost controls. Explore the practical five-day course.
lede: Cloud migration planning helps IT managers, cloud architects, application owners, and infrastructure teams assess workloads and sequence moves to cloud services. Participants practise mapping dependencies, selecting migration strategies and service models, planning migration waves, controlling costs, and shaping governance and post-cutover operations.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who shape workload selection, migration sequencing, cloud governance, or the operating model after cutover.
modules: NIST Cloud Models and Migration Drivers
Cloud Service Selection and Landing Requirements
ISO Cloud Controls and Shared Responsibility
FinOps Framework, Contracts, and Cost Controls
Migration Execution, Cutover, and Service Handover
prerequisites: Prior experience with business applications, IT infrastructure, or technology service operations will help you apply the workload and operating-model exercises. No programming is required.
